verdict.rationale: Neon's Management API is versioned (base URL /api/v2) with a full OpenAPI spec and machine-readable endpoint index, and the MCP server docs show a concrete, dated deprecation policy (SSE endpoint deprecated, stops working Oct 1 2026; stdio package deprecated in favor of hosted server). This is real evidence of versioning plus at least one documented deprecation timeline, but there's no broader, general-purpose deprecation policy statement covering the core Management/Data APIs themselves. Missing for 10: an explicit general API deprecation/versioning policy page for the core Management API (not just MCP transport), and independent confirmation that deprecated versions are supported for a stated period.
